name: lime-agent
description: Lets coding agents see, debug and drive a running Lime app through a loopback endpoint (HTTP and WebSocket) and an MCP server.
releasenote: The endpoint runs on crossbyte, and apps also answer over a WebSocket, which can push log and error events. Native builds need libhxcpp in place of hxcpp: run haxelib run libhxcpp setup once.
